meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I'm Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes.

My son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me. Why am I hearing about this from him?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.

"Cheated." Okay. I'm writing that word down.

You haven't shown me one document yet, Hale. What do you have, and who has seen it?
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

You're asking me to explain a log I haven't seen. Owen tells me he wrote that essay over the weekend.

Who pulled those times, and can I read them myself?
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
"Made up." Which line, Hale, and in what words? You still haven't answered me about the times either.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too?

You've given me a time, a number and a line you won't quote. I'm not leaving here without that zero withdrawn, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.
"Take it or leave it." You put a zero in the gradebook before you picked up the phone, so you don't get to give me ultimatums. Withdraw it first, and then we can talk about anything else.

I've answered. The zero comes off before I discuss anything else.

Is what you read me on paper, or only on your screen?
